content.text: Submitted. The proposal now sits cleanly at the preferred level: a single concise Section 11.5.1 insertion adding a mutual cap at the greater of "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim" and USD 1,000,000, leaving the existing (A)–(D) carve-outs uncapped and adding data protection/security and other-party IP infringement, with Customer's payment obligations expressly not damages. All official checks and the minimality gate pass.
